Lily plays tennis with Jack every Monday. Lily learned a lot about history. Lily is reading a book about history. In fact, the loft was insulated to keep the house warmer.
Life is full of small surprises. Lily drinks coffee after doing sports. Lily hopes to visit London one day. Also, her birthday party is on the fifteenth of June.
They took many photos at the old photo album. Lily wrote about the day in the diary. Jack is interested in drawing.
